title: 大阪杯の後に・Just a Dream…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Right. I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Woo, Fine Motion! Great job!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (It was just as fun as always, and everyone seems happy.)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: What was up with Fine Motion?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? She was fantastic out there!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I mean, sure. But don't you think she was a little different than at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup? Like she didn't seem to be enjoying it like before.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: She didn't seem quite like herself to me. Or maybe it's just my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: About today… Were you feeling okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, I guess it's nothing, then… I just thought maybe there was something wrong.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Your smile seemed a bit… forced.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sorry! It's none of my business! I'm sure it was just my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …I guess you saw right through me, haha. I did feel just a bit out of sorts.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So I was right! You shouldn't push yourself too hard. Make sure you get plenty of rest today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to race you again when you're in peak condition!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's smile is strained after the race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This is no good. I thought I'd be okay, but…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Do you mind if we go for a walk later?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmm… The sunset is so lovely. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The sunsets are very beautiful back in Ireland too. I did so love watching them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But I always used to wonder—why does the sun have to set? We could have much more fun if night never came.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I always found it a bit sad… Not that I've ever told that to anyone before.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's just like Shakur said. I'm not content with this at all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've gone and done it… I let myself feel like I didn't want things to end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But this time of fun and happiness will be over soon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Once I return home, my days here will become distant memories, and… eventually, I'll forget them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My time here has been like a dream and, just like any dream, it will eventually fade away…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Nothing will remain. It will be like it never happened at all…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I just find that so awfully sad—so utterly melancholic. That's why…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've begun to wish that I could stay here forever. I want to continue racing long, long after I've crossed my finish line.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even though I know there's no such thing as forever.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: PHEEEW!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, I feel much better! I see—this is what Shakur was talking about!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If I run while wishing that things won't end, it will only make my legs grow heavy. I won't be able to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's why I had to say it out loud and get it all off my chest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There are certain concessions required of my heart… but a pillar of the people I shall become.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! What a weight off my shoulders! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her smile has changed from how it was only a short time ago. It seems she really has moved past her doubts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! Now that I think about…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We still haven't discussed our next race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If you have a plan, then I'd very much like to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do have something in mind. Fine Motion is tremendously popular right now, and there's a race her fans no doubt hope she'll run in.
choice_data_list: Why don't we aim for the Takarazuka Kinen?
Why don't we aim for the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! Isn't that a Grand Prix? The fans decide who can run…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'd be thrilled if I was able to join. I'll have to smile with my entire heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that our next objective has been decided, I'd like to try discussing her real feelings once more, but…

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: My apologies, Your Highness. Everyone is waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Right. Let's begin making arrangements for when I return home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You can go ahead, Trainer. But let's ride the bullet train back to the academy together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Do I have time to fix my makeup? Please forward the documents to my phone…
choice_data_list: (Is this a look into her "normal" routine?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must have spent her whole life acclimating her feelings to the reality of her situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is this truly the best way she could be going about it? By pushing any feeling of discontent to the sidelines?
